The claim accurately reflects the definition, variable descriptions, and context provided in Source [S2]. The source explicitly defines $E_m(T)$ with the same summation formula, identifies $k$ and $l$ as the counts of scalar and vector fields respectively, defines $E_{s,i}$ and $E_{v,i}$ as the errors for the respective fields, and identifies $b_i$ as normalization coefficients.
